description: Static verified local method and routine registry. Handlers are data for review and a hardcoded dispatcher allowlist, never eval/import/subprocess instructions.

execution_policy.initialization_exception: Only init may create a new .atlas control tree in the explicitly selected root; it refuses existing control state.
execution_policy.writer_protocol: Output publication serializes cooperating writers with .writer.lock and expected-manifest comparison. Adapter-managed project/state/generations must be written only by import_matrix refresh under IMPORT.lock; external writers ignoring these locks are outside the guarantee. Compare plus os.replace is not an atomic OS compare-and-replace against uncooperative writers.
execution_policy.canonical_mutation_limits: Only explicit native source-relocate apply/reconcile may change the exact qualified entry/metadata rows; no general rewrite waiver or target authority.

cursor.omitted: Start from the verified CURRENT pointer.

preconditions: Selected output CURRENT and each returned release can be read and verified.
Archive continuation requires an exact next_cursor anchor; missing/corrupt pages refuse when requested.
Archive output path must bind to its project root. Historical raw source availability is not rechecked by history.
outputs: Archive: newest-first VERIFIED_PAGE or a fully traversed VERIFIED_CHAIN; bounded revisions and matrix bindings, cumulative matrix_history_total, has_more/next_cursor, actual file targets and VERIFIED_AT_IMPORT source qualification.
Caller-supplied continuation remains VERIFIED_PAGE with ancestry_to_current=NOT_RETRAVERSED_FOR_CALLER_SUPPLIED_CURSOR, even on its final page.
Legacy without archive: full chronological verified retained chain and unreferenced releases; --limit validated but not used to truncate, --cursor refused.
No archive orphan scan or old raw source reads. Legacy SHA-only tail resolution may read manifest headers on this explicit history request; the count is reported.
methods.reconcile: Follow each exact page link and cumulative total. A not-yet-loaded page or absent pre-Atlas raw version remains unverified/UNKNOWN. Source bytes can be checked separately with pins on the returned path; never reconstruct missing history as actual.
